<b>Undersweeps</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are the [[Underworkers|Underworker]] variant of [[Pilgrim Guide]]s dedicated to scrubbing away soot with their long steel-bristled pins.<ref>Undersweep Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Uses their steel-bristled pin to scrub the soot from vents and pipes."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Undersweeps are often stationary as they sweep vents, but begin to walk once they notice Hornet. Once Hornet is in range, they use one of two attacks:
* <b>Flail Sweep:</b> Rears back briefly before thrusting their brush forward, shaking it around for a second before stopping.
* <b>Jump Swing:</b> Jumps up with a variable horizontal trajectory and does a large overhead swing with their brush as they land.

Undersweeps deal {{Damage|1}} with their attacks as well as upon contact.

Due to them often being encountered in tight passages and hallways, make sure to have a retreat option, as their attacks can cover a lot of area quite quickly.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Undersweeps have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|* For the light, unseen...
* These halls kept clean...
* Rest and fade...
* We... were chosen...
* See us faithful!
* Shells bend, shells break...
* Through duty, purity...
* The sacred toil...|columns=2}}

== Location ==
Undersweeps can be found throughout the [[Underworks]], with one fought as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 2|enemy gauntlet]] in the middle of the area, and another during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 3|gauntlet]] in [[the Cauldron]].
